Item.Name: S_EQUIP_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter Equipment type, leave blank for all, use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :s_equip_type is not null 
 then
 
 declare
 dtLocalDate Date:=get_local_date; -- Added to handle time zone issues 
 begin
 select code_desc into :s_equip_desc
 from equip_master_codes 
 where code_type='EQUIP'
 and code=:s_equip_type 
 and dtLocalDate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, dtLocalDate);
 --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate); -- Added to handle time zone issues 
 exception when no_data_found then
 show_error('3124'); -- invalid equipment type
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
else
 :s_equip_desc:=null;
end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* This Procedure Checks Out Duplicate Records while entering...
 equipment type 
*/
PROCEDURE dupli_check IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 temp_v_equip_type varchar2(4);
 temp_v_proc varchar2(2);
 temp_v_product_code varchar2(8);
 temp_v_parm_code varchar2(5);
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(2);
 BEGIN
 temp_v_equip_type := :equip_type; 
 temp_v_proc := :proc; 
 temp_v_product_code := :product_code; 
 temp_v_parm_code := :parm_code; 
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 WHILE :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 LOOP
 IF temp_v_equip_type = :equip_type AND
 temp_v_proc = :proc AND
 temp_v_product_code = :product_code AND
 temp_v_parm_code = :parm_code AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no
--Check if the record No. is not the same as current record
--and then check if all the fields are same as fetched 
--into temporary variables
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_local_date(vDate IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN date IS
 vLocalDate Date;
BEGIN
 
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,vDate ,vLocalDate);
 else
 vLocalDate := vDate;
 end if;
 return vLocalDate;
END;
